posts.title: Exfiltrating GitHub Gists
posts.description: snippet by FND May 14, 2026 Everyone’s leaving the dilapidated slop factory. My own efforts were stumped by GitHub’s account-data export being incomplete: Gists were missing. Recovering them was a matter of assembling a couple of throwaway scripts.

posts.title: Text Compression with Web Standards
posts.description: snippet by FND January 25, 2026 An ill-advised return to the rabbit hole of personal web apps and client-side secrets left me with a series of usability challenges. Naturally, those could only be addressed by fumbling with byte streams.

posts.title: Animated Hamburger Icon
posts.description: snippet by FND September 19, 2025 While I’m generally skeptical of hamburger menus, sometimes they seem unavoidable – or at least pragmatic in a resigned kind of way. So we might as well try to get the icon right.
